scope: Local in-memory React design simulation; not real permissions, database, concurrency, hosted or physical-device proof
cases: complete return, revision, exact publication and minimal Guardian projection
successor remains private until publication; withdrawal removes current family view; old snapshots retained internally
lost committed reply reconciles exactly once without replacement
uncommitted loss retains input without claiming save
confirmed write with failed read requires reload; no duplicate write
concurrent draft preserves unsaved text and reloads expected version
missing public text and rejected write do not simulate success
current assignment, ended session and different-account review denial simulations
empty, loading and read failure are distinct and recoverable
dirty navigation guard and EN/AR preserve draft; desktop/phone layout and screenshots
